clue.text: Sailor, the first native?

parts.note: AB, able seaman, is the usual crossword sailor
the first of its kind is the original one

explanation.surface: A question about whether some sailor was the very first inhabitant of a land.
explanation.definitionFit: An indigenous inhabitant of a country, especially Australia, is a native of it.

clue.text: It is bound to appeal to readers

definitions.text: It is bound to appeal to readers

parts.words: It is bound to appeal to readers
parts.note: bound means held in covers with stitching and glue, not tied up or certain, and readers are its audience

explanation.surface: Something that is sure to be popular with readers.
explanation.definitionFit: A volume of printed pages in a binding is meant for readers.

clue.text: Right round with company's repeated art style

parts.note: a round shape is the letter O

indicators.note: the clue says the company piece is given twice over

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company; the 's is a link

explanation.surface: Describes some ornate decoration with right-angled company motifs repeated.
explanation.definitionFit: The ornate eighteenth-century decorative manner of curlicues and shells is a named style of art.

clue.text: Man puts arm in clothing

indicators.note: in says the arm piece goes inside the man piece

parts.note: a gent is a man
taken as written

explanation.surface: A man pushes his arm into a sleeve as he dresses.
explanation.definitionFit: Any article of dress, such as a coat or shirt, is an item of clothing.

clue.text: Votes against one's reorganisation

indicators.note: reorganisation tells us to rearrange the letters of the words before it

explanation.surface: A vote against a proposed restructuring of some organisation.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of "one's" counts as a letter S here, so ONES rearranges into the four letters needed.
explanation.definitionFit: Negative votes in a division are counted as the noes, the opposite of the ayes.

clue.text: Leaves to dress for a meal

definitions.text: Leaves to dress for a meal

parts.words: Leaves to dress for a meal
parts.note: reads like someone going off to change clothes before dinner, but leaves are salad greens and dress means add a dressing

explanation.surface: Someone departs to put on smart clothes before dinner.
explanation.definitionFit: A salad plant whose green foliage is tossed in vinaigrette at table.

clue.text: Ark lamp?

parts.note: sounds like an arc lamp, but Noah's Ark rode the Deluge, so its lamp would be one for the Deluge

explanation.surface: A punning question about the lighting on Noah's vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: An arc lamp is a powerful electric light; spelt Ark it points to Noah and the Deluge, giving a lamp named after that great inundation.
explanation.definitionFit: A powerful lamp lighting a stadium or building, here jokingly the light of the great Deluge.

clue.text: Adequate stock on the railway

parts.note: something adequate is good enough
stock in the sense of lineage or breed is strain

explanation.surface: Enough rolling stock running along the railway line.
explanation.definitionFit: A freight train is something found running on the railway.

clue.text: Coming from Laos as well

indicators.note: coming from says new letters are produced out of the word that follows, rearranged

explanation.surface: Something that also originates in the Asian country Laos.
explanation.definitionFit: Also is a plain synonym of in addition, as well.

clue.text: Many on course acting together

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for a hundred, so many
taken as written
a current is the course or flow of a river

explanation.surface: Lots of people on a course behaving in unison.
explanation.definitionFit: Things running simultaneously or in agreement are said to be acting together.

clue.text: To Rodney, included one shaped like an anchor-ring

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: included says one is put inside the shortened name

parts.note: Rod is short for the name Rodney
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Telling Rodney he has been included in something ring-shaped.
explanation.definitionFit: A doughnut-shaped solid, a ring like that at the top of an anchor, is the geometric figure meant.

clue.text: Long boa squirming in Italy

indicators.note: a squirming snake twists about, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A long boa constrictor wriggling about somewhere in Italy.
explanation.definitionFit: The city in Emilia-Romagna is a place in Italy.

clue.text: Where to find publicans-in prison?

definitions.meaning: pub landlords serve from behind their counters
jailed, locked up in a cell

explanation.surface: A joking question about landlords being jailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Publicans stand at the back of their counters, while convicts are locked away behind cell grilles.

clue.text: She was more than just a bareback rider!

definitions.text: She was more than just a bareback rider!

parts.words: She was more than just a bareback rider!
parts.note: a bareback rider has no saddle, but this legendary Coventry noblewoman rode with no clothes at all

explanation.surface: A circus performer famed for riding without a saddle.
explanation.walkthrough: Legend says the Coventry noblewoman rode naked through the town to protest her husband's taxes.
explanation.definitionFit: The noblewoman of legend rode through Coventry naked, so more than bareback.

clue.text: Cant work paintings out

indicators.note: out reads as outside, so the paintings piece goes round the work piece

parts.note: paintings collectively are art
a machine that works is said to go

explanation.surface: Someone cannot finish working out some paintings.
explanation.definitionFit: Cant is the jargon or slang of a particular group, a secret language.

clue.text: Feverish colour

definitions.meaning: the word names a childhood fever with a rash

explanation.surface: A feverish flush of colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Scarlet fever is the infectious illness, and the same word is a vivid red hue.

clue.text: Empty northerner to dart off

indicators.note: to here means added in, so the empty letter joins the northerner inside

parts.note: a Scot comes from the north of Britain
empty means nothing, the letter O

explanation.surface: A hungry northerner rushes off.
explanation.definitionFit: To scoot is to go off quickly, to dash away.

clue.text: Find time before the event

parts.note: a race is a sporting event

explanation.surface: Locating the time before a sporting event starts.
explanation.definitionFit: To trace something is to track it down and discover it.

clue.text: Do not show skin

explanation.surface: Someone told not to show any skin.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep something concealed is one sense; an animal's pelt is another.

clue.text: Georgia back with artilleryman in India

indicators.note: back says the Georgia letters are read in the reverse direction

parts.note: GA is the postal abbreviation for the US state
RA, the Royal Artillery, stands for a gunner

explanation.surface: A gunner returns from Georgia to serve in India.
explanation.definitionFit: The city of the Taj Mahal is a place in India.

clue.text: Does not finish greeting the wise man

indicators.note: the greeting is cut short, dropping its final letter

parts.note: so long is a parting greeting

explanation.surface: Someone never quite finishes saying hello to a sage.
explanation.definitionFit: The Athenian lawgiver, whose name now means any wise legislator or sage.

clue.text: Mark will withdraw from the race

definitions.meaning: a small graze or score on a surface
to take a horse or runner out of a contest

explanation.surface: Someone called Mark pulls out of the race.
explanation.definitionFit: A light score on a surface is one sense; striking an entrant off a race list is another.

clue.text: It is simplicity to tie Evan in knots

indicators.note: tied in knots means twisted about, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Tying a man named Evan up in knots is easy.
explanation.definitionFit: Artlessness or innocent lack of sophistication is a kind of simplicity.

clue.text: Not notice the lack of proper care

definitions.meaning: to overlook, pay no attention to

explanation.surface: Failing to notice that someone is not being cared for.
explanation.definitionFit: Overlooking something is one sense; failure to look after a person is another.

clue.text: Jibe made by one for the most part in town

parts.note: a jibe is a taunt

indicators.note: only most of the word is used, dropping its final letter

parts.note: taken as written before trimming

explanation.surface: A jibe mostly made by one person in town.
explanation.definitionFit: The county town of Somerset in south-west England is a town.

clue.text: Papal messenger, one who is devoted, one in business

parts.note: a nun is devoted to religious life

indicators.note: in says the numeral goes inside the business piece

parts.note: CO, company, stands for a business
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A list describing the Pope's messenger as devout and businesslike.
explanation.definitionFit: The Pope's diplomatic representative to a foreign government is his envoy, a papal ambassador.

clue.text: Go with a debutante shortly round the wine-shop

indicators.note: round says these letters are turned about into a new order

parts.note: deb is the short form of debutante

explanation.surface: Inviting a debutante to go round to the wine bar.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish word for a wine cellar or shop selling wine.

clue.text: Mother to the Germans or father to the French

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest's title
au means to the in French

explanation.surface: Comparing the German word for mother with the French one for father.
explanation.definitionFit: The German word means a woman or wife, so a mother would be addressed that way in Germany.

clue.text: A look amusement, broadly speaking

parts.note: a face showing pleasure, with broadly hinting at the wide smile

explanation.surface: A face that shows amusement, in general terms.
explanation.walkthrough: Broadly speaking looks like 'in general', but here it means a wide smile, the broad one of the stock phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide smile is an expression signalling amusement.

clue.text: Sixty, but most of the batsmen get a duck

definitions.text: most of the batsmen get a duck
definitions.meaning: if most batsmen are out for nought, only a trio make any runs

explanation.surface: A cricket team collapses with most batsmen out for nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: A duck in cricket is a score of nought; if most of the eleven score nothing, just a trio of batsmen got runs.
explanation.definitionFit: A score is twenty, so three of them make sixty; a trio scoring runs reads the same.

clue.text: Talk wildly, giving a right welcome

parts.note: ave is a Latin greeting, a word of welcome

explanation.surface: Someone talks enthusiastically, giving a warm greeting.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak incoherently or with frantic enthusiasm is to rant.

clue.text: Unable to leave home-or travelling there?

definitions.meaning: confined indoors by illness or age
on the way to the home, heading for the dwelling

explanation.surface: Someone stuck indoors, or someone on their way back.
explanation.definitionFit: Confined to one's dwelling is one sense; heading for the dwelling is the other.
